title: Johnny and Baby Dodds and Jimmie Noone
summary: They talk about the Dodds brothers and Jimmie Noone.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Mm-hmm. By the way, do you remember Johnny Dodds? I know his brother very well is still living, Baby Dodds.
Oh, that's right. Johnny the heavy one and Baby the younger. Baby's a little one. Yes, I sure remember. It's been a long time since I heard his name called.
Baby had a stroke again. He's had several strokes.
Just like the Bob Rands, the two brothers of drummers.
Mm-hmm. Yeah, the two of them. You remember Jimmy Noon? Did you ever play with Jimmy Noon, a young clarinet player in those days? He went to Chicago.
Jimbo. Oh, yeah. A little short of it?
I don't know. He was pretty short.
Yeah, he was very short. Jimbo. Ah, he was a light, like it. Yes, sir. I've never seen. No, I'm too much.
He came up later than Big Eye and all those stars. Yes, sir.
